Explore Luggage & Suitcases at STRAND


From a quick weekend escape to a long-haul adventure, our luggage collection has you covered. Whether you know exactly what you're after or you're starting from scratch, here's how our range breaks down.

[**Hard suitcases**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/hard-suitcases) offer superior protection for your belongings, with scratch-resistant shells, secure TSA combination locks, and smooth spinner wheels that handle everything the airport throws at them.

[**Soft suitcases**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/soft-suitcases) are lightweight and flexible, with expandable compartments that give you a little extra room when you need it most.

[**Carry-on luggage**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/carry-on-luggage) is sized to fit in the overhead locker, keeping your essentials within reach and your checked baggage fees at zero.

[**Check-in luggage**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/check-in-luggage) gives you the space to pack for longer trips without compromise - available in medium and large sizes to suit every itinerary.

[**Dual-opening suitcases**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/dual-opening) open from both ends for easy access to everything you've packed, without having to dig through layers to find what you need.

[**Lightweight cases**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/lightweight-cases) are engineered to give you maximum packing capacity while keeping the weight of the bag itself to a minimum - ideal for travellers who want to make the most of their baggage allowance.

[**Luggage sets**](https://www.strandbags.com.au/collections/luggage-sets) take the guesswork out of matching your bags, with coordinated carry-on and check-in cases designed to stack, store, and travel together seamlessly.

## Shop Luggage Online or In-Store at STRAND

Ready to find your next travel companion? Shop our full range of luggage and suitcases online with [free standard Australia-wide delivery](https://www.strandbags.com.au/pages/deliveries-and-returns) on orders over $99, or grab yours today with free 3-hour Click & Collect at your nearest STRAND store.
